text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Kikuka Sho, the final race of the Classic Triple Crown, is before us. The crowd roars in anticipation of the drama that will unfold.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Symboli Rudolf, meanwhile, merely waits in silence.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Conventional wisdom holds that the Kikuka Sho goes to the strongest Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: A 3,000-meter course with two uphill stretches is apt to test any racer's mental fortitude.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: It demands speed, stamina, and technique in equal measure. Only an Umamusume who excels in every area can hope to win the day.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: If I were to cede that crown to another, I could hardly presume to call myself Emperor.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: But as thanks for your faith in me, allow me to be your escort.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Come with me, Trainer… and we shall see the highest of heights together.
